hooks.name: Mandatory 12-Min Chat Log → CREAT.md
hooks.description: Every time a user prompt is submitted, appends a timestamped chat log entry to CREAT.md. Mandatory for all agents.

action.command:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "
$logFile = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..\CREAT.md'
$now = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'
$stdin = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
try { $ctx = $stdin | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $ctx = @{} }
$prompt = if ($ctx.userPrompt) { ($ctx.userPrompt -replace '`r`n','  ' -replace '`n','  ')[0..200] -join '' } else { '(prompt not captured)' }
$entry = \"`n## [$now] — Kiro (AutoLog)`n`n**User said:** $prompt`n`n**Agent did:** (session in progress — see subsequent entries)`n`n**Files changed:** (pending)`n`n---`n\"
Add-Content -Path $logFile -Value $entry -Encoding UTF8
"
